asof_rule: Use only facts whose measurement end and SEC filed date are on or before the selection as-of date; a frozen panel may use the selection only on or after that date.
survivorship_note: The public SEC-float membership rule is forward-only from the first archived symbol snapshot. The separate private liquidity diagnostic can look back no earlier than the Massive market_eod archive, which begins in 2024-07. Neither rule may be represented as a historical universe before its source archive begins.
license_note: US-government public-domain source data (17 USC 105); derived work, freely redistributable.
rank_observation_rule: For each listed, non-ETF, non-test-issue SEC CIK, select the newest-filed positive finite dei:EntityPublicFloat observation whose measurement end and filed date are both on or before asof, whose filed date is within max_observation_age_days of asof, whose value is at most max_public_float_usd, at most max_float_to_revenue times the issuer's newest fiscal-year revenue (skipped below float_revenue_floor or when revenue is unfiled), and at most max_float_jump_vs_recent times the median of the issuer's up-to-five prior observations (skipped below two priors); rank descending and break equal values by seating order.
comment: v2 (2026-08-03). Changes from liq1000_v1, each fixing a measured defect in the committed 2026-07-30 selection: common-equity-first seating (Comcast was represented by its ZONES note CCZ instead of CMCSA on alphabetical order); an explicit plausibility ceiling and filed-date recency bound; and two second signals — float-to-revenue (every corrupt cover-page float measured >=1,260x annual revenue while no real issuer exceeds ~135x) and jump-vs-own-history (corrupt filings jump >2,000x the issuer's recent median; genuine growth peaks below ~11x). Cabot Corp's $4.43 quadrillion cover-page tag ranked FIRST under v1. The v1 spec and its dated artifacts remain immutable history.
